title: Estimating Rail Commuter Preferences under Endogenous Crowding: A Population Game Approach to Train Choice in Tokyo
abstract: arXiv:2611.02592v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We estimate commuters' preferences over schedule delay, travel time, and crowding from observed train choices on a commuter rail line in Tokyo. Because crowding is itself an outcome of these choices, we model train choice as a game in which train choices and crowding are jointly determined, and estimate the preferences by maximum likelihood using the closed-form stationary distribution of the game. Using individual-level data from Japan's 2015 Public Transport Survey for Metropolitan Areas matched with train timetables, we construct desired arrival times from reported work start times rather than inferring them from observed arrival times. We find that schedule delay costs are large relative to crowding costs. One minute of schedule delay early and late corresponds to 0.39 and 0.49 minutes of in-vehicle travel time, respectively, whereas one minute of travel at a crowding rate of 100% adds a cost equivalent to 0.04 minutes. translated_title: 内生拥挤条件下的轨道交通通勤者偏好估计：基于种群博弈方法的东京列车选择研究
translated_abstract: 我们根据东京某通勤铁路线路上观测到的列车选择行为，估计通勤者对时刻延误、旅行时间和拥挤的偏好。由于拥挤本身正是这些选择的结果，我们将列车选择建模为一个博弈，其中列车选择与拥挤程度是联合决定的，并利用该博弈的闭式平稳分布，通过极大似然法估计偏好参数。研究使用了日本2015年大都市圈公共交通调查的个人层面数据，并与列车时刻表相匹配，同时基于受访者报告的上班开始时间构建期望到达时间，而非从观测到的实际到达时间进行推断。研究发现，时刻延误成本相对于拥挤成本而言要大得多：早到和晚到一分钟的时刻延误分别相当于0.39分钟和0.49分钟的车内旅行时间，而在拥挤率为100%的情况下，每分钟旅行所增加的成本仅相当于0.04分钟。
tldr: 该研究将东京通勤者的列车选择建模为列车选择与拥挤程度联合决定的种群博弈，利用博弈的闭式平稳分布通过极大似然法估计偏好，发现时刻延误成本远大于拥挤成本——早到和晚到一分钟分别相当于0.39和0.49分钟的车内旅行时间，而100%拥挤率下每分钟旅行的成本仅相当于0.04分钟。
en_tdlr: This study models Tokyo commuters' train choice as a population game in which train choices and crowding are jointly determined, estimating preferences via maximum likelihood with the game's closed-form stationary distribution, and finds that schedule delay costs are large relative to crowding costs—one minute of early or late schedule delay equals 0.39 and 0.49 minutes of in-vehicle time respectively, whereas one minute of travel at 100% crowding adds a cost equivalent to only 0.04 minutes.
